75:t_1:57.en:
$$甲児$$
「Next stop, the $$アメリア$$ Continent...!」

75:t_1:58.en:
$$勝平$$
「And there, we take down the $$サイデリアル$$!!」

75:t_1:59.en:
$$レド$$
「You heard it, $$チェインバー#pilot$$. This is my answer.」

75:t_1:60.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Understood. As your Pilot Support Enlightenment Interface, this unit respects your judgment.」

75:t_1:61.en:
$$レド$$
(I'm off, $$ベベル$$... and you too, $$ガルガンティア船団$$...)

75:t_1:62.en:
$$レド$$
(Someday, I will return with $$エイミー$$... By then, I want to become someone who believes I am needed, too...)

75:t_10:5.en:
$$スズネ$$
「I can't stop thinking about that man $$ギルター$$ we fought again today...」

75:t_10:9.en:
$$スズネ$$
「That man $$ギルター$$... He doesn't seem to be fighting for a mission so much as out of something more personal... out of hatred...」

75:t_10:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Yes, good eye. I think you're quite right.」

75:t_10:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well... I suppose that's the trademark of that unit...」

75:t_10:13.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But even that hatred is one of the human emotions... Thanks to it, when that man's ship was destroyed, it produced high-quality $$Ｚチップ$$.」

75:t_10:14.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That amount... 100 Z. I'll add this to the unit's stock.」

75:t_10:15.en:
$$スズネ$$
「You really can't think of anything but $$Ｚチップ$$, can you, $$ＡＧ$$?」

75:t_10:16.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Naturally. $$Ｚチップ$$ are the key to saving the world.」

75:t_10:19.en:
$$スズネ$$
「...I was a fool for asking.」

75:t_10:20.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Now, now, Miss $$スズネ$$. Please calm down.」

75:t_10:21.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「If you're scared of the likes of $$ギルター$$, you'll never be able to fight on the $$アメリア$$ Continent.」

75:t_10:22.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Trying to scare me like that won't work on me anymore.」

75:t_10:23.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(I'm telling a fair bit of truth, actually... Well, scaring her needlessly wouldn't do any good, so let's leave it at that.)

75:t_10:24.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(Do your best, Miss $$スズネ$$. I... have high hopes for you.)

75:t_10:30.en:
$$エイミー$$
「Wow! There are talking machines besides $$チェインバー#pilot$$ and $$アル$$!」

75:t_10:31.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Yes. I am $$ＡＧ$$... a Customer Support Enlightenment Interface.」

75:t_10:33.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Put simply, I'm a dimensional merchant's agent robot.」

75:t_10:34.en:
$$レド$$
「Incomprehensible. That is no explanation at all.」

75:t_10:35.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Don't worry about it. What I said earlier was a Dimension Joke.」

75:t_10:36.en:
$$レド$$
「I understand even less...! What is a Dimension Joke...!?」

75:t_10:37.en:
$$エイミー$$
($$レド$$... $$ガロード$$ said it's best not to get too involved with this machine...)

75:t_10:39.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「$$レド$$, if you want to understand someone, one method is to first try acting the same way they do.」

75:t_10:43.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「All right, here we go. Are you ready?」

75:t_10:45.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then let's give it our all again today...!」

75:t_10:51.en:
$n
「Being honest is a good thing, but at this rate he'll just become $$ＡＧ$$'s plaything.」

75:t_10:52.en:
$$宗介$$
「As I thought, we can't leave it to $$チェインバー#pilot$$ alone.」

75:t_10:55.en:
$n
「Let's make sure he can smile like a human being.」

75:t_10:56.en:
$$スズネ$$
「That's a good attitude, both of you.」

75:t_10:57.en:
$$かなめ$$
「So deep down, they really did mind being called sullen, huh.」

75:t_10:58.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Hee hee... Do your best, $n, $$宗介$$. You too, $$レド$$.」

76:t_000:0.en:
$$キャシー$$
「The sea is blue around here...」

76:t_000:1.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「There aren't many Light Bugs around here. Basically, we're already off the fleet's route.」

76:t_000:3.en:
$$ミーナ#pt251$$
「Nanomachines in the ocean that generate electricity and give off light. Thanks to them, this Earth's seas look emerald green.」

76:t_000:4.en:
$$ボビー$$
「So that's why the sea glows in the middle of the night. It's those Light Bugs.」

76:t_000:5.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Apparently, after the $$残されの海$$ was transferred here, the Light Bugs spread from it to the seas all over the world.」

76:t_000:6.en:
$$ボビー$$
「I wonder, does that have any bad effect on the sea creatures?」

76:t_000:7.en:
$$ラム$$
「According to Captain $$テスタロッサ$$'s investigation, it's the opposite. The Light Bugs apparently work to purify pollutants in the sea.」

76:t_000:8.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Nanomachines that purify the sea, huh...」

76:t_000:9.en:
$$キャシー$$
「Ensign $$レド$$, $$エイミー$$, $$ピニオン$$... Thank you for coming all this way to see us off.」

76:t_000:10.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Don't mention it. You folks looked after us, after all.」

76:t_000:11.en:
$$エイミー$$
「Besides... both $$レド$$ and I wanted to say a proper goodbye to everyone...」

76:t_000:13.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Warning. A group of units approaching this area has been detected.」

76:t_000:14.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Identification signal: $$サイデリアル$$.」

76:t_001:0.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Tch...! To run into them while in transit...!」

76:t_001:1.en:
$$ギルター$$
「But if meeting like this is fate, then I will follow it and crush them!」

76:t_001:2.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「So it's $$ギルター・ベローネ$$'s unit.」

76:t_001:3.en:
$$テッサ$$
「All units, launch! He's coming after us!」

76:t_002:0.en:
$$キャシー$$
「Ensign $$レド$$, take $$エイミー$$ and the others to a safe place.」
